aiReadyLines.text: Sample Question 113
Answer any five of the following questions from the poems in
your textbook. 2x5=10
(a) Who are the two people claiming responsibility for the child in the
poem "Whose Child is This?"?
(b) What does the poem "Whose Child is This?” suggest about the responsi-
bilities of parents and teachers?
(c) What are some of the things the poct sees while traveling on the train in
the poem " From a Railway Carriage’?
(d) What is meant by painted station in the poem "From a Railway
(e) What does the poet compare the speed of the train to, and why in the
poem "From a Railway Carriage"?
(f) What does Leisure mean in the poem" Leisure"?
(g) What is the main theme of the poem "Leisure"?
(h) How does the poet describe the moon in the poem “Under the Full
Part B - Writing (Marks: 30)
Read the opening of a story below and complete it in at least ten
new sentences. Give a suitable title toit. 10
Ina small village, there lived a greedy farmer named Alam. He had plenty of land and
cattle, but he always wanted more. One day, a wise old man told him about a magical
offer. "If you run from sunrise to sunset, all the land you cover will be yours," he said.
12.Write a paragraph on “Patriotism” in 150 words. 10
13.Suppose you are Alpona. You are having a chat with your friend,
Jamil about both of your favourite sports.
Now, write a dialogue between you and your friend on your favourite sports. 10
Class 7 English Forma-15
